title: Strategy
line: We work out who you are for, and what you say first.
intro: A logo drawn before you know who it is for is a guess. So we start with three questions. Who is this for? What else can they choose? What do you say first? We write the answers down, and every later decision, from your colour to the first line of your website, can be checked against them.
